note: Three calibrated SQLite fixtures have passing initial live trials. These are preliminary smoke trials, with unequal invocation ceilings across E05 arms and no stochastic repeats. Full 26-case model benchmark and fair repeated comparisons remain incomplete. Failed trials are retained separately.
